verse: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
story: The room is quiet after the feet have been washed, Judas has gone out into the night, and Jesus has only a short time left with the Eleven.

He calls the commandment new, though Israel had long been told to love a neighbour. What is new is the measure: as I have loved you. They have just watched that love kneel with a towel and wash the feet of the one who would betray Him, and of the one who would deny Him. It will go on to a cross by morning. This is love with a pattern to follow, and Jesus says it will be how the world knows His disciples.
Think of one person this week who is hard to love. Start with a small act of service, the way He started with a basin.
